G1_unambiguity.justification: The stage transformation, allowed ordering, objective, and required output are stated precisely without leaving a reasonable alternative interpretation.

G2_completeness.justification: It includes the necessary bounds, input format, update rule, initial value, usage condition, objective definition, output format, and representative edge cases.

G3_faithfulness.justification: The recurrence and objective are exactly equivalent to the two-machine completion-time recurrence, so every input has the same optimal value as in the original problem.

G4_naturalness.justification: The statement is clear and readable, though the signal-intensity interpretation and “inefficiency rating” are somewhat contrived compared with the original scheduling formulation.
